title: Raspberry
summary: Heals 1d4 HP for no action resource and can contribute 1 Camp Supply.

fields.Eat: Restore 1d4 HP without spending an Action or Bonus Action in combat. Triggers effects that activate when healed.
fields.Acquisition: Berry bushes in the Forest near Scratch and around the one-time Wyrm’s Lookout campsite.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
